newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The lower Chamber of Deputies has ratified the Romanian-Hungarian treaty, endorsed by the Senate last week. Deputies also ratified the Romanian-Yugoslav treaty.
* Romania's parliament to hold joint session next week to discuss government's decisions for November 3 general polls.

* General George Joulwan, Supreme Allied Commander of all NATO Forces in Europe met Romanian President Ion Iliescu. Joulwan said signing of Romanian-Hungary treaty is major step for both countries' plans to join NATO.
* Romanian retired army general Nicolae Militaru lodged his presidential candidacy at Central Electoral Bureau. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
